  "canonical_python_code": "import numpy as np
from scipy.optimize import least_squares


def calibrate_affine_gauges(
    command: np.ndarray, measured: np.ndarray, check_group: np.ndarray,
    groups: np.ndarray, *, stress_scale: float, prior: np.ndarray | None = None,
    pair_span: float = 0.05, consensus_span: float = 0.10,
    residual_tol: float = 0.001, spot_tol: float = 0.02,
) -> tuple[np.ndarray, np.ndarray]:
    """Return [gain, bias] by requested group and a local-identifiability mask.

    Command, measurement and bias use the same stress units. Tolerances are
    fractions of stress_scale; candidate pairs must also span 5% of the local
    command range. Fit a strict-majority consensus of at least three checks.
    Otherwise keep the externally supplied per-group prior gain (nominal 1 by
    default) and update the prior bias only with compatible spot checks.
    """
    if not (np.isfinite(stress_scale) and stress_scale > 0 and
            0 < pair_span <= consensus_span and 0 < residual_tol <= spot_tol):
        raise ValueError('invalid stress scale or calibration tolerances')
    x = np.asarray(command, dtype=float) / stress_scale
    y = np.asarray(measured, dtype=float) / stress_scale
    check_group, groups = np.asarray(check_group), np.asarray(groups)
    maps = (np.tile([1., 0.], (len(groups), 1)) if prior is None
            else np.array(prior, dtype=float, copy=True))
    if maps.shape != (len(groups), 2) or not np.isfinite(maps).all() or np.any(maps[:, 0] <= 0):
        raise ValueError('expected one finite positive-gain affine prior per group')
    maps[:, 1] /= stress_scale
    finite = np.isfinite(x) & np.isfinite(y)
    identified = np.zeros(len(groups), dtype=bool)
    for k, label in enumerate(groups):
        use = finite & (check_group == label)
        a, b = x[use], y[use]
        h = max(3, len(a) // 2 + 1)
        best = None
        if len(a) >= h and np.ptp(a) >= consensus_span:
            i, j = np.triu_indices(len(a), k=1)
            sep = np.abs(a[j] - a[i]) >= max(pair_span, 0.05 * np.ptp(a))
            for u, v in zip(i[sep], j[sep]):
                gain = (b[v] - b[u]) / (a[v] - a[u])
                if gain <= 0:
                    continue
                err = b - gain * (a - a[u]) - b[u]
                keep = np.abs(err) <= residual_tol
                if keep.sum() < h or np.ptp(a[keep]) < consensus_span:
                    continue
                design = np.column_stack((a[keep], np.ones(keep.sum())))
                fit = np.linalg.lstsq(design, b[keep], rcond=None)[0]
                resid = b - (fit[0] * a + fit[1])
                support = np.abs(resid) <= residual_tol
                count = support.sum()
                if fit[0] <= 0 or count < h or np.ptp(a[support]) < consensus_span:
                    continue
                score = (-count, float(resid[support] @ resid[support]))
                if best is None or score < best:
                    best, maps[k], identified[k] = score, fit, True
        if not identified[k]:
            delta = b - (maps[k, 0] * a + maps[k, 1])
            close = np.abs(delta) <= spot_tol
            if close.any():
                maps[k, 1] += np.median(delta[close])
    maps[:, 1] *= stress_scale
    return maps, identified


def align_reference_features(
    raw: np.ndarray, reference: np.ndarray, group: np.ndarray, stratum: np.ndarray,
) -> tuple[np.ndarray, np.ndarray]:
    """Return reference-aligned features and the pre-imputation complete mask.

    Use all allowed reference rows, including prediction rows when available.
    Each group uses the median column mean and median population standard
    deviation across reference columns with at least two observations.
    For each missing feature, give every observed group-stratum cell equal
    weight, irrespective of specimen count. An unobserved column or a group
    without a positive reference scale is not identifiable.
    """
    x = np.array(raw, dtype=float, copy=True)
    r = np.asarray(reference, dtype=float)
    _, g = np.unique(group, return_inverse=True)
    _, s = np.unique(stratum, return_inverse=True)
    observed = np.isfinite(x)
    for label in np.unique(g):
        use = g == label
        panel = r[use]
        finite = np.isfinite(panel)
        cols = finite.sum(axis=0) >= 2
        if not cols.any():
            raise ValueError('group has no estimable reference panel')
        panel = np.where(finite[:, cols], panel[:, cols], np.nan)
        center = np.median(np.nanmean(panel, axis=0))
        scale = np.median(np.nanstd(panel, axis=0, ddof=0))
        if not (np.isfinite(scale) and scale > 0):
            raise ValueError('group reference scale must be positive')
        x[use] = (x[use] - center) / scale
    _, cells = np.unique(np.column_stack((g, s)), axis=0, return_inverse=True)
    count = np.zeros((int(cells.max()) + 1, x.shape[1]))
    total = np.zeros_like(count)
    np.add.at(count, cells, observed)
    np.add.at(total, cells, np.where(observed, x, 0.))
    contributing = (count > 0).sum(axis=0)
    if np.any(contributing == 0):
        raise ValueError('a feature has no observations in any cell')
    means = np.divide(total, count, out=np.zeros_like(total), where=count > 0)
    fill = means.sum(axis=0) / contributing
    return np.where(observed, x, fill), observed.all(axis=1)


def fit_predict_hereditary(
    history: np.ndarray, hold: np.ndarray, durations: np.ndarray, times: np.ndarray,
    initial_strain: np.ndarray, features: np.ndarray, complete: np.ndarray,
    training: np.ndarray, strain_observed: np.ndarray, rate_observed: np.ndarray,
    *, time_scale: float, stress_scale: float, strain_scale: float,
    yield_stress: float, tau_bounds: tuple[float, float], seed_scale: float = 0.05,
    mad_multiplier: float = 2.5, noise_floor: float = 1e-8, rank_rtol: float = 1e-8,
) -> tuple[np.ndarray, np.ndarray, np.ndarray, np.ndarray]:
    """Return physical relaxation times, weights, strain curves and onset rates.

    History has one row per specimen and one column per piecewise-constant
    pre-hold interval, in chronological order. Memory starts at zero before
    that history. Inputs are calibrated and strictly sub-yield; the hold has
    no viscoplastic term. Features are aligned and imputed, and complete marks
    the rows that originally had all features. Both observation arrays may
    contain NaN. Only complete training rows identify shared weights. Outputs
    cover all rows. A finite onset rate on an incomplete row is assumed
    trustworthy and updates only its drift, with no feedback into the fit.

    Fit in units of the supplied positive time, stress and strain scales.
    Initialize with multistart soft-L1 (scale 0.05 in normalized channels),
    then perform two Cauchy refinements with separate strain and rate scales
    of 2.5 times their normalized MAD estimates, floored at 1e-8. No coefficient
    ridge is applied; reject locally unidentified fits instead. Weights are
    ordered as two strain-per-stress amplitudes, followed by the intercept
    and feature slopes in strain per time.
    """
    scales = np.array([time_scale, stress_scale, strain_scale, yield_stress,
                       seed_scale, mad_multiplier, noise_floor, rank_rtol])
    if not np.isfinite(scales).all() or np.any(scales <= 0):
        raise ValueError('physical and fit scales must be finite and positive')
    h = np.asarray(history, dtype=float) / stress_scale
    p = np.asarray(hold, dtype=float) / stress_scale
    d = np.asarray(durations, dtype=float) / time_scale
    t = np.asarray(times, dtype=float) / time_scale
    lo, hi = np.asarray(tau_bounds, dtype=float) / time_scale
    if not (0 < lo < hi < np.inf) or np.any(d < 0) or np.any(t < 0):
        raise ValueError('expected positive ordered time bounds and nonnegative times')
    lim = yield_stress / stress_scale
    if not (np.all(np.abs(h) < lim) and np.all(np.abs(p) < lim)):
        raise ValueError('calibrated history and hold must be strictly sub-yield')
    eps0 = np.asarray(initial_strain, dtype=float)
    c = np.column_stack((np.ones(len(p)), np.asarray(features, dtype=float)))
    complete = np.asarray(complete, dtype=bool)
    use = np.asarray(training, dtype=bool) & complete
    eps = (np.asarray(strain_observed, dtype=float) - eps0[:, None]) / strain_scale
    rate_unit = strain_scale / time_scale
    rate = np.asarray(rate_observed, dtype=float) / rate_unit
    curve_rows, curve_cols = np.nonzero(use[:, None] & np.isfinite(eps))
    rate_rows = np.flatnonzero(use & np.isfinite(rate))
    ncurve, nrate = len(curve_rows), len(rate_rows)
    nweight = c.shape[1] + 2
    if min(ncurve, nrate) == 0 or ncurve + nrate < nweight + 2:
        raise ValueError('insufficient complete training observations')
    y = np.r_[eps[curve_rows, curve_cols], rate[rate_rows]]
    tail = np.r_[np.cumsum(d[:0:-1])[::-1], 0.] if d.size else d
    fit_rows, inverse = np.unique(np.r_[curve_rows, rate_rows], return_inverse=True)
    ci, ri = inverse[:ncurve], inverse[ncurve:]
    tc = t[curve_cols, None]

    def jump(tau: np.ndarray, histories: np.ndarray, holds: np.ndarray) -> np.ndarray:
        memory = np.exp(-tail[:, None] / tau) * -np.expm1(-d[:, None] / tau)
        return holds[:, None] - histories @ memory

    def design(tau: np.ndarray) -> np.ndarray:
        j = jump(tau, h[fit_rows], p[fit_rows])
        curve = np.column_stack((j[ci] * -np.expm1(-tc / tau), c[curve_rows] * tc))
        onset = np.column_stack((j[ri] / tau, c[rate_rows]))
        return np.vstack((curve, onset))

    def unpack(q: np.ndarray) -> np.ndarray:
        first = lo + (hi - lo) * q[0]
        return np.array([first, first + (hi - first) * q[1]])

    def residual(q: np.ndarray) -> np.ndarray:
        return design(unpack(q)) @ q[2:] - y

    bounds = (np.r_[0., 1e-5, np.full(nweight, -np.inf)],
              np.r_[1. - 1e-5, 1., np.full(nweight, np.inf)])
    starts = ((.01, .13), (.03, .36), (.06, .68), (.10, .24), (.14, .75), (.30, .94))
    candidates = []
    for start in starts:
        a = design(unpack(np.asarray(start)))
        w = np.linalg.lstsq(a, y, rcond=None)[0]
        candidates.append(least_squares(residual, np.r_[start, w], bounds=bounds,
                                        loss='soft_l1', f_scale=seed_scale, max_nfev=160))
    q = min(candidates, key=lambda result: result.cost).x
    for _ in range(2):
        err = residual(q)
        group_scales = []
        for block in (err[:ncurve], err[ncurve:]):
            mad = 1.4826 * np.median(np.abs(block - np.median(block)))
            group_scales.append(max(noise_floor, mad_multiplier * mad))
        sigma = np.repeat(group_scales, [ncurve, nrate])
        opt = least_squares(lambda x: residual(x) / sigma, q, bounds=bounds,
                            loss='cauchy', max_nfev=400)
        q = opt.x
    singular = np.linalg.svd(opt.jac, compute_uv=False)
    if not opt.success or singular[-1] <= rank_rtol * singular[0]:
        raise ValueError('shared fit did not converge to an identifiable solution')
    tau, w = unpack(q), q[2:]
    j = jump(tau, h, p)
    amplitude = j * w[:2]
    drift = c @ w[2:]
    onset = amplitude @ (1. / tau) + drift
    informed = ~complete & np.isfinite(rate)
    correction = np.zeros_like(onset)
    correction[informed] = rate[informed] - onset[informed]
    curve = amplitude @ -np.expm1(-t[None, :] / tau[:, None])
    curve += (drift + correction)[:, None] * t
    physical_weights = w * np.r_[np.full(2, strain_scale / stress_scale),
                                np.full(nweight - 2, rate_unit)]
    return tau * time_scale, physical_weights, eps0[:, None] + strain_scale * curve, rate_unit * (onset + correction)
",
  "synthetic_unit_test_code": "import numpy as np


def run_self_test():
    # Check that a gross check does not move the identified gain, while a
    # sparse group updates only its prior offset. Repeat in rescaled units.
    cmd = np.array([-.8, -.3, .2, .7, .9, .6, .8])
    lab = np.array([0, 0, 0, 0, 0, 1, 1])
    measured = np.r_[1.2 * cmd[:5] + .14, .9 * .6 - .04, 2.]
    measured[4] += .8
    prior = np.array([[1., 0.], [.9, -.05]])
    groups = np.array([0, 1])
    maps, identified = calibrate_affine_gauges(cmd, measured, lab, groups, stress_scale=2., prior=prior)
    np.testing.assert_array_equal(identified, [True, False])
    np.testing.assert_allclose(maps, [[1.2, .14], [.9, -.04]], atol=1e-12)
    f = .01
    maps_scaled, identified_scaled = calibrate_affine_gauges(f * cmd, f * measured, lab, groups, stress_scale=2. * f, prior=prior * [1., f])
    np.testing.assert_array_equal(identified_scaled, identified)
    np.testing.assert_allclose(maps_scaled, maps * [1., f], atol=1e-12)

    rng = np.random.default_rng(51)
    n = 48
    idx = np.arange(n)
    lab = idx % 2
    stratum = ((idx // 2) % 3 == 0).astype(int)
    x_true = rng.normal(size=(n, 4))
    raw = x_true.copy()
    raw[[-3, -2], 0] = np.nan
    ref = np.repeat((2 * ((idx // 2) % 2) - 1)[:, None], 4, axis=1)
    x, complete = align_reference_features(raw, ref, lab, stratum)
    cell_means = [np.nanmean(raw[(lab == g) & (stratum == s), 0]) for g in (0, 1) for s in (0, 1)]
    np.testing.assert_allclose(x[[-3, -2], 0], np.mean(cell_means), atol=1e-12)
    a = np.where(lab == 0, 2., 5.)[:, None]
    b = np.where(lab == 0, -3., 4.)[:, None]
    x_gauge, complete_gauge = align_reference_features(a * raw + b, a * ref + b, lab, stratum)
    np.testing.assert_array_equal(complete_gauge, complete)
    np.testing.assert_allclose(x_gauge, x, atol=1e-12)

    # Generate the physical response with the step recursion, independently
    # of the solver's closed-form interval weights.
    h = rng.uniform(-1.3, 1.3, (n, 4))
    hold = rng.uniform(.2, 1.5, n)
    dt = np.array([.22, .65, .31, 1.1])
    t = np.linspace(0., 4.5, 24)
    eps0 = rng.uniform(-.01, .01, n)
    tau = np.array([.52, 2.5])
    w = np.array([.032, .019, .018, .004, -.003, .002, .0015])
    memory = np.zeros((n, 2))
    for stress, step in zip(h.T, dt):
        decay = np.exp(-step / tau)
        memory = memory * decay + stress[:, None] * (1. - decay)
    amp = (hold[:, None] - memory) * w[:2]
    drift = w[2] + x_true @ w[3:]
    strain = eps0[:, None] + amp @ (1. - np.exp(-t / tau[:, None])) + drift[:, None] * t
    onset = amp @ (1. / tau) + drift
    train = idx < n - 4
    curve_obs = strain.copy()
    flat_idx = rng.choice(np.flatnonzero(np.broadcast_to(train[:, None], strain.shape)), size=int(.08 * train.sum() * t.size), replace=False)
    curve_obs.flat[flat_idx] += rng.choice([-.35, .35], size=flat_idx.size)
    curve_obs[~train] = np.nan
    onset_obs = onset.copy()
    onset_obs[-1] += .5  # A complete prediction row must ignore this observation.
    onset_obs[-2] = np.nan  # Incomplete row without an anchor retains its prior.
    kwargs = dict(time_scale=2., stress_scale=2., strain_scale=.05, yield_stress=2., tau_bounds=(.20, 8.))
    tf, wf, pred, rate = fit_predict_hereditary(h, hold, dt, t, eps0, x, complete, train, curve_obs, onset_obs, **kwargs)
    assert all(np.isfinite(v).all() for v in (tf, wf, pred, rate))
    np.testing.assert_allclose(tf, tau, rtol=.015)
    np.testing.assert_allclose(wf, w, atol=4e-4)
    expect = strain.copy()
    expect_rate = onset.copy()
    unobserved = (x[-2] - x_true[-2]) @ w[3:]
    expect[-2] += unobserved * t
    expect_rate[-2] += unobserved
    np.testing.assert_allclose(pred, expect, atol=5e-4)
    np.testing.assert_allclose(rate, expect_rate, atol=3e-4)
    np.testing.assert_allclose(rate[-3], onset_obs[-3], atol=1e-12)

    # Scale stress by 0.01 and halve all times; scale onset rates as 1/time.
    # The time transformation preserves duration/tau, not a new material law.
    k = .5
    tt, ww, pp, rr = fit_predict_hereditary(f*h, f*hold, k*dt, k*t, eps0, x_gauge, complete_gauge, train, curve_obs, onset_obs/k, time_scale=2.*k, stress_scale=2.*f, strain_scale=.05, yield_stress=2.*f, tau_bounds=(.20*k, 8.*k))
    np.testing.assert_allclose(tt / k, tf, rtol=2e-5)
    np.testing.assert_allclose(ww * np.r_[[f, f], np.full(5, k)], wf, atol=2e-6)
    np.testing.assert_allclose(pp, pred, atol=2e-6)
    np.testing.assert_allclose(rr * k, rate, atol=2e-6)


run_self_test()
"
